```{r}
dim(stops)
colnames(stops)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

stops <- stops %>% filter(search_conducted == TRUE)
dim(stops)
pct <- nrow(stops) / 268669

cat("Searches were conducted in %", round(pct * 100, 1), "of stops.")
```

```{r}
stops_with_cb <- stops %>% filter(contraband_found == TRUE)
dim(stops_with_cb)
pct <- nrow(stops_with_cb) / nrow(stops)
pct2 <- nrow(stops_with_cb) / 268669

cat("Contraband was found in %", round(pct * 100, 1), "of searches and %", round(100* pct2, 1), "of all stops.")
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(stops))
```

```{r}
stops_with_missing_stop_time <- stops %>%
  filter(is.na(stop_time), contraband_found == TRUE)
pct <- nrow(stops_with_missing_stop_time) / nrow(stops)
cat("Contraband was found in %", round(pct * 100, 1), "of searches with n/a stop_time.\n")

stops_with_missing_search_type <- stops %>%
  filter(is.na(search_type), contraband_found == TRUE)
pct <- nrow(stops_with_missing_search_type) / nrow(stops)
cat("Contraband was found in %", round(pct * 100, 1), "of searches with n/a search_type.\n")

stops_with_missing_is_arrested <- stops %>%
  filter(is.na(is_arrested), contraband_found == TRUE)
pct <- nrow(stops_with_missing_is_arrested) / nrow(stops)
cat("Contraband was found in %", round(pct * 100, 1), "of searches with n/a is_arrested.\n")

stops_with_missing_stop_outcome <- stops %>%
  filter(is.na(stop_outcome), contraband_found == TRUE)
pct <- nrow(stops_with_missing_stop_outcome) / nrow(stops)
cat("Contraband was found in %", round(pct * 100, 1), "of searches with n/a stop_outcome.")
```
